label: HK replan: Conrad-based Oct 30/31 + Oct 29 corrected to actuals (Justin's decisions)
notes: v1: initial v2.2 content manifest. v2: Settings footer test change. v3: Macau-HK deep dive guide + 8-stop audio tour. v4: content version display + honest update feedback in Settings, index.html and esim-usage.json excluded from the manifest (shell frame and volatile usage file), and the Huangshan Baiyun confirmation image added to the overlay. v5: Oct 28 Macao arrival day in full detail in all three day-plan options (corrected MF8719 2:45 PM departure, 12:15 hotel departure, T4 check-in, optional CZBANK tax refund, Venetian shuttle + indoor walk to Four Seasons, MGM Cotai rewards + Spectacle, Rua do Cunha evening, two Taipa dinner options); docs/itineraries.json re-merged from content/ (built file was stale since Oct 17). v6: app.js fix — the bundled (APK) load path now also fetches itineraries.json through the content-updater interception, so day-plan changes published as content updates (like v5's Oct 28 plan) actually reach the installed app; previously the APK used only the itinerary inlined at build time. Falls back to the inlined copy on any failure. v7: Settings > Content updates now shows what's actually on this phone — installed content version (re-fetched live when Settings opens and after every check), the number of downloaded content files overriding the bundle, and a fingerprint of the itinerary in use (Oct 28 stop count + first stop + data date) — so a stale display can't hide behind 'up to date'. v8: the Macau–Hong Kong deep dive is split per day at Justin's request — Oct 28 gets Macau (customs, apps, top 10, Stop 1), Oct 29 gets Taipa morning (Stop 2) + the Hong Kong arrival reference (customs, apps, top 10, Stop 3), Oct 30 gets Stops 4–5, Oct 31 gets Stops 6–7, Nov 1 gets Stop 8. Each day page now shows only its own deep dive; the combined guide remains as fallback until the split files download. android/build-apk.sh now inlines the five per-day guides for future APK builds. v9: the combined Macau–Hong Kong guide is retired at Justin's request — file removed from docs/ and the updates mirror, app.js fallback blocks and the build-apk.sh inline removed; the five per-day deep dives are the only version now. v10: test update — no content changes, version bump only, to test the content-update function on the installed app. v11: Oct 29 replanned at Justin's decision (evening of Oct 28) — the 2:00 PM crossing is replaced by a full Macao day and the 8:30 PM TurboJET night sailing: 9:00 AM Belcanção breakfast (FHR breakfast-for-two), Donna departs 10:30 AM, Taipa Village late morning, 12:45 PM Zi Yat Heen dim sum on the $100 FHR property credit, 3:45 PM checkout (FHR 4 PM guarantee, bags with concierge), 4:00 PM Wynn Palace SkyCab + Performance Lake, peninsula golden hour (A-Ma Temple flex, Senado Square, Ruins of St Paul's 5:51 PM sunset), Macanese dinner, Taipa Ferry Terminal by 8:00 PM, Conrad check-in ~10:05 PM. All three day-plan options rewritten for Oct 29; master itinerary row + onward note updated; the Oct 29 deep-dive guide carries an update banner and revised Stop 2/Stop 3 slots (the Peak sunset moves to Oct 31's Stop 7; Mak's Noodle and Yung Kee move to Oct 30/31). v12: app.js fix — the Settings version line now reads the content-version.json body regardless of fetch ok (the APK kept showing "bundled" after successful updates); no itinerary or guide changes in v12 itself (Oct 29 replan is Milo's v11, kept intact). v13: Hong Kong days replanned at Justin's decision (evening of Oct 29, Milo) and Oct 29 corrected to what actually happened. Oct 29 (all three options): peninsula golden-hour block dropped; Zi Yat Heen lunch 1:30 PM on the FHR credit; Wynn Palace via LRT (SkyCab + Wynn Rewards desk); 6:30 PM Four Seasons shuttle -> 7:00 PM Cotai Water Jet (the v11 plan's 8:30 PM TurboJET does not run on Thursdays); MTR to Admiralty, Conrad check-in ~8:20 PM. The Oct 29 guide banner + Stop 2/Stop 3 slots corrected to match. Oct 30 (all three options converge on the decided day): Garden Cafe breakfast at the Conrad 6:30 AM (Lin Heung dropped — hotel breakfast every morning is the new default), Dragon's Back 7:50 AM via MTR + Citybus 9 to To Tei Wan, Shek O lunch, back ~2:15 PM, Tai Kwun + PMQ + Central-Mid-Levels escalators in the afternoon (Justin's pick over a hotel-rest afternoon), Star Ferry + Avenue of Stars 6 PM, A Symphony of Lights 8 PM, Temple Street ~8:30 PM + Mong Kok graze (moved from Oct 31). Oct 31 (all three options converge): Jardine's Lookout sunrise + Maxim's Palace dropped; slow Garden Cafe breakfast, Big Buddha + Po Lin Monastery via Ngong Ping 360 from ~9 AM (monastery vegetarian lunch), Executive Lounge refreshments 3-5 PM, Peak farewell sunset 5:47 PM, Golden Leaf farewell dinner 7:30 PM in the Conrad (where the ~US$200 property credit is spent). Big Buddha deliberately NOT on flight day Nov 1, which stays a slow morning + 12:30 PM Airport Express for CX840. Guides: Oct 30 guide gains a Tai Kwun text block and revised Stop 4/5 slots; Oct 31 guide's Stop 6 is rewritten for Lantau and its stale sunrise narration removed (see agents note), Stop 7 re-slotted to Peak + Golden Leaf. Master itinerary rows for Oct 29/30/31 and the Macao onward note updated. Sham Shui Po frame hunt: dropped by Justin — it was never in itineraries.json (only a side list), so nothing to remove. Per COORDINATION.md this publish was claimed first (Milo, content v13).
